Class JsonWriter

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.utils.JsonWriter
@Internal public final class JsonWriter extends Object
Writes JSON without a JSON library on the processor class path: the configuration metadata, the configuration schemas, the reports and the generated sources that embed JSON literals.

The writer builds the document in memory, so no method throws; writeTo(Writer) and toString() hand the result out. Members are separated automatically: a value written into an array, or a name written into an object, follows the previous one with a comma. Every value of an object must be preceded by its name, and every begin must be matched by its end before the document is complete; a misuse fails with an IllegalStateException rather than producing malformed JSON. 

String json = new JsonWriter()
    .beginObject()
    .name("name").value("timeout")
    .name("type").value("java.time.Duration")
    .name("tags").beginArray().value("io").value("client").endArray()
    .endObject()
    .toString();
